pathway.description: A: schizophrenia, D: unemployment, E: chronic homelessness. Best parameter set from literature-supported range.

target._estimate: HUD 2024 PIT: 153,000 chronically homeless / 335M US population = 0.000457

_rationale: P(D|A)=0.85: Marwaha & Johnson (2004) meta-analysis shows 80-90% unemployment in schizophrenia. P(E|D)=0.22: modest +10% adjustment to LLM estimate based on long-term unemployment-homelessness association.
